name: Zenra de Nude Model o Saserareta Tsuma ◆ Jigoku hen
original_name: 全裸でヌードモデルをさせられた妻 ◆地獄編
source:
"Could you stand it if your own wife was a nude model?"

Ichirou Oda, college art professor, is about to be married to Yoko.
But when Yoko accidentally damages a painting, she must complete a series of nude modelling scenes before the wedding... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE059917.html]DLSite English[/url]]
